𝗕𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗔 𝟭𝟯𝟬, 𝗨𝗔𝗘 𝟮𝟰𝟵/𝟴! 🔥

Harpreet Bhatia's 130 off 144 lifts UAE to 249/8 vs India A in Doha. Arshad Khan took 4/43.
India A need 250 to win and book a semi-final spot.

Can they chase it? 👇
